notes: «كلاهما عن المعتمر» makes the two heads co-transmitters; «قال ابن حبيب حدثنا معتمر بن سليمان» restates the same Mu'tamir with his full name, which the rules do not merge (rule 9), so both are kept and the archive should decide whether they are one man; «قال سمعت أبي» names the father of Mu'tamir only by relation; the Prophet's words are the saying
